now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 133, Kora, Daisy's lost sister, joins Nathaniel Malick.

proposed.text: In episode 133, Kora, Daisy's lost half-sister, fights for Nathaniel Malick until Coulson takes her captive.

changes.evidence: Kora joins Nathaniel in episode 131 ('After, Before'). In episode 133 ('Stolen') Daisy learns Kora is her half-sister and, after Yo-Yo and Mack rescue Coulson, 'the latter takes Kora captive'. Episode 134 then opens with her held by S.H.I.E.L.D. So the episode 133 record should end In custody, not At large.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
proposed.text: In episode 136, Kora turns on Nathaniel Malick, joins May in filling the Chronicoms with empathy, and revives Daisy.

changes.evidence: Episode 135 ('The End Is at Hand'): Daisy talks Kora down and she lets them escape, and Nathaniel knocks her out. Episode 136 ('What We're Fighting For'): 'May and Kora combine their abilities to give empathy to the Chronicoms', and 'Kora revives' Daisy; a year later Daisy explores the cosmos with Sousa and Kora. The file ends at episode 134 with her At large on Malick's side, so her change of sides is missing.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
proposed.text: In episode 119, after his bomb plan fails, Sarge kills Pax, and Mack overpowers him and has him locked up at the Lighthouse.

changes.evidence: 'after': -1 means this goes BEFORE step 0. Sarge is captured twice with no record: May brings him back to base in episode 115 ('The Other Thing') and he is freed in a deal in episode 117 ('Toldja'); then in episode 119 ('Collision Course Part 2') 'Sarge kills Pax in anger after learning the bomb plot failed... Mack frees himself with Yo-Yo's help and overpowers Sarge... S.H.I.E.L.D. celebrates their victory while Sarge is imprisoned.' He escapes in episode 120 ('Leap'), which leaves the existing episode 122 record At large.

now.title: What If...?
now.text: In episode 3, Loki brings Asgard's army to avenge Thor, helps catch the killer, then stays to rule Earth.

changes.evidence: Episode 3 takes place entirely in the universe where the Avengers candidates are killed, which the app labels 'Hank Pym's world' (T:by-hank-pym uses it for the same episode). Loki's record has no place.

now.title: What If...?
now.text: In episode 9, the Watcher brings Natasha from Ultron's world to save Nick Fury, and she subdues Loki with his own scepter.

changes.evidence: In episode 9 the Watcher 'brings her to one in which the Avengers candidates were assassinated, where she helps to defeat Loki' (fandom: Black Widow steals the Scepter and uses it to subdue him). That is the same universe labelled 'Hank Pym's world'.

now.title: What If...?
now.text: In season 3, now the living soul of his restored universe, Strange strips the Eminence and two other Watchers of their power.

changes.evidence: Episode 26: Carter 'transport[s] everyone to Strange Supreme's universe where Strange, having become the sentient consciousness of that universe, removes the powers of the Eminence, Incarnate, and Executioner.' The Eminence file (T:by-the-eminence k1) places the same event at 'Strange Supreme's world'; this record has no place.
